regions.merged_text: Many thanks for your kind remembrances and prayers. Thanks be to God, though I've had several colds etc. these past months. My health has been good. Today however a real "cold" seems trying to get hold on me .... Deo Gr. Of course I was - am - pleased to know of your dear Father's success in selling that property, so long on the market, etc. We pray his health - as well as M's improve speedily. Whatever comes, however, let us try at least to be re- signed . As to my reception of your letters, please do not worry. For several years I have not been able to even read the majority of my letters to say nothing of answering them. I hardly know what I would have to do if I had no Fr. Jerome or some one to substitute him. In fact I have been thinking for some time of leaving the answering of all letters to some one else - provided by the Rev. Fr. Guardian. Please say a prayer for my guidance in this regard too. I surely do sympathize with so many poor people in the world, - struggle, struggle, Str. Well, that too can be offered up as a sort of martyrdom. So let us keep courage .... Keep faith with God at all events and save our souls. . . .
